title: BenchX projection
description: How stored results become series (docs/design/benchmark-result-schema.md section 4.3): the facts a series follows (its axis), and for every other reported fact whether it must match, as is or normalized, or is ignored. A project's identity policy is the projection the store maintains on ingest; any other projection, including the comparison profiles of section 5.5, can be materialized over the same results into series of the same form.
$comment: Rules the server enforces: paths are JSON Pointers into the result, limited to the reported coordinates (project, source, benchmark, coordinates) plus /revision/key and /provenance/subject_tree, and for an axis also /provenance/labels/<key>; an axis path always wins over a role, and otherwise the longest matching path wins, so a role on a subtree can be overridden for one member; a null fact never equals anything; an ignored fact whose value differs from the previous point of a series is recorded as a warning on that point; an identity policy's axis is /revision/key; a projection whose axis has neither /revision/key nor /provenance/subject_tree must match /provenance/subject_tree unless mixed_code is true; any change other than description needs a new identity_schema.

identity_schema.description: Versioned name of the projection. Enters comparison_fingerprint, so series of different projections never mix.

axis.description: The facts a series follows, and how their values are ordered. Several paths make one axis value per distinct combination, as in a two-factor study.

default.description: Role of every reported fact that is neither on the axis nor named in paths.

mixed_code.description: True when the projection deliberately puts results of different code at one axis value, such as a trend over time.

estimators.description: Estimators to materialize series for. Used when the projection is maintained as series; a comparison names its own.

invariants.description: Checks a set of results must pass before any comparison under this projection (section 5.5).

oneOf.description: match: equal values share a series. ignore: kept on the result and never splits a series; a change along a series is flagged on the point.
Match after normalizing: version-prefix keeps the first depth components (2.39.1 at depth 2 is 2.39); map replaces values by a table, keeping unlisted ones; canonical-uri normalizes a source URI.
